votes.reason: At 22.9x trailing earnings that fell 26.1%, with a guide the draft says was raised twice, this $380.4bn franchise is priced on depressed rather than inflated earnings, has already reported and moves only 2.74% a week.
A $910.6bn bank at 15.7x trailing earnings that grew 13.4%, already reported and with the book's lowest weekly volatility at 2.12%, is the cheap, sound holding my lens looks for.

30.4x is a premium price, not a bargain, but it buys 19.0% EPS growth in a capital-light payments network that moves only 2.64% a week and does not report until Jul 30, so my lens has no concrete reason against it this week.

The 43.8x P/E and -15.9% EPS are GAAP figures that real-estate depreciation distorts, which is why I picked it as the cheapest REIT on FFO, and with 3.18% weekly volatility and no report until Aug 10 that case holds through Friday.
